project_context.archetype: 2 (Performance Pro) - Tactical, Elite Athleticism, High Contrast
project_context.core_problem: Navigation cognitive overload, unrecognizable active states, microscopic text (8px), flat visual hierarchy combining 3 distinct levels of navigation into one row of circles.

sizes.forbidden: NEVER use 8px (text-[8px]). Absolute minimum size is text-xs (12px) for overlines or tiny badges, and text-sm (14px) for interactive navigation labels.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Spatial Separation. Never combine global navigation (Group A) and contextual data navigation (Group B & C) in the same horizontal plane.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous padding for touch targets: min h-10, px-4, py-2.

navigation_blueprint.architectural_shift: Move from a single overloaded Topbar to a 'Global Topbar + Contextual Sidebar' layout. This naturally solves the 'too many options' problem.

level_1_global_topbar.description: Group A items (Panel, Datos, Scouting, Reporte, Sesiones). A persistent horizontal bar at the top.
level_1_global_topbar.layout: flex items-center justify-between w-full h-16 px-6 bg-[#0A0A0A] border-b border-[#333333]
level_1_global_topbar.item_structure: Row-based. Icon on left, Text on right (hidden on extremely small mobile, but default visible).

states.default: text-zinc-400 flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 rounded-md transition-all duration-200

level_1_global_topbar.right_actions: Group D (FABs: SuperAdmin, Idioma, Perfil) remain on the far right of the Topbar, separated by an auto-margin or flex spacer.

level_2_and_3_contextual_sidebar.description: When the user is in the 'Datos' panel, a Left Sidebar appears managing Group B (Sections) and Group C (Sub-sections). This utilizes an Accordion pattern.
level_2_and_3_contextual_sidebar.layout: w-64 h-[calc(100vh-64px)] flex-shrink-0 border-r border-[#333333] bg-[#0A0A0A] overflow-y-auto hidden md:block
level_2_and_3_contextual_sidebar.mobile_strategy: On mobile, this becomes a slide-out drawer or an expandable Shadcn Accordion right below the header.

group_b_sections_accordion_header.description: The 7 colored sections. Instead of filling the whole circle with color, use the color as a sophisticated accent (e.g., a left border or a tiny 8px dot).
group_b_sections_accordion_header.classes: flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 transition-colors
group_b_sections_accordion_header.color_implementation: Dynamically apply border-l-{color}-500 when active, or render a <div className='w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-{color}-500' /> next to the label. This tames the 'rainbow' effect while keeping the mental mapping.

group_c_sub_sections_accordion_content.description: The 1 to 9 items inside a specific Group B section. Shown in a vertical list directly under the expanded Section header.
group_c_sub_sections_accordion_content.classes: flex flex-col pl-10 pr-4 py-1 space-y-1 bg-[#0A0A0A]
group_c_sub_sections_accordion_content.item_classes: flex items-center px-3 py-2 text-sm text-zinc-400 rounded-md transition-colors hover:text-white hover:bg-zinc-800/50
group_c_sub_sections_accordion_content.active_item_indicator: Instead of full shapes, the active sub-item gets a subtle colored background and primary brand text color.

alternative_horizontal_only_pattern.description: If the business explicitly refuses a Left Sidebar, implement a Two-Tier Horizontal Architecture.
alternative_horizontal_only_pattern.tier_1: Top Bar: Group A (exactly as defined above).
alternative_horizontal_only_pattern.tier_2: Secondary Sticky Bar below Top Bar. Uses a scrollable Tab List (Shadcn Tabs) for Group B. Active state is a bold border-bottom: border-b-2 border-{color}-500.
alternative_horizontal_only_pattern.tier_3_subnav: Pill-based horizontal scroll under Tier 2 for Group C. flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto. Pills are px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm. Active pill is bg-[#007AFF] text-white.

prioritized_action_plan.step_1: Kill the 8px circles: Immediately switch all navigation items to a Text + Icon Flex Row pattern with a minimum text size of 14px (text-sm).
prioritized_action_plan.step_2: Fix Active States: Replace the 'fill color change' with high-contrast Active States. Use bg-[brand]/10 + text-[brand] + font-bold. The user must know instantly where they are.
prioritized_action_plan.step_3: Separate Global from Contextual: Extract Group B and Group C from the Top Navigation bar. Move them into a Left Sidebar (Accordion) or a distinct secondary horizontal tab bar when 'Datos' is active.
prioritized_action_plan.step_4: Tame the Rainbow Colors: Stop using the 7 section colors as massive filled shapes. Use them as subtle visual cues (left borders, 8px dots, or thin underlines) to reduce visual fatigue.
prioritized_action_plan.step_5: Accessibility Pass: Ensure every interactive item has a focus ring (focus-visible:ring-2), clear contrast (WCAG AA), and proper data-testid attributes for testing.

testing_attributes.rule: Every single navigation element MUST include a data-testid attribute.
